Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): opportunity cost is the correct selection metric - a lane's next experiment is worth funding only if it changes a downstream decision more than the best alternative use of that lane.
Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): shared measurement substrates should be repaired once at the lowest layer that unblocks the most live questions, rather than re-repaired per lane.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): a producer PASS is not evidence when an independent audit says MEASUREMENT_INVALID or REVISE; measurement design is a first-class scientific object with its own pre-freeze attainability checks.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): a mechanism not yet exercised end to end by a real external agent cannot license product-level claims, but credential-free substrate work can legitimately establish the prerequisite liveness first.
Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): frozen scientific transactions must complete before strategic redirection, whereas pre-freeze designs may be superseded by a new mandate.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: I considered PIVOT to C-PARAM-INHERIT, which the audit also names for Graph and which is more central (executable parameterized mechanism). I did not, because Product is this cycle pivoting onto the C-PARAM-INHERIT treatment-arm liveness question, and duplicating the same mechanism round trip in two lanes would spend two units of the scarcest resource on one question. Graph's comparative advantage right now is a ready, precisely specified certificate repair that a single re-frozen run can decide, whereas a fourth C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE pass is expected to reproduce the joint-authorship control-plane defect. Continuing C-FRESHNESS therefore buys the freshness prerequisite now and leaves the mechanism claim to a lane that is already being pointed at it.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER has 422 canonical experiments but the integrated causal chain (observation -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the shipped kernel -> applicability/freshness -> real external agent action -> lower end-to-end cost) remains unproven end to end. The recurring failure mode is not null science but invalid instruments at the certificate/control layer (three consecutive C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE packets, the C-FRESHNESS GATE-C3 predicate, the frontier stationarity-label packet, and the physics M2/M3 control-plane dead end), plus one genuine external blocker: the C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark cannot run without a programmatic model credential. The highest-leverage moves are therefore substrate/treatment-path repair and unblocking the external comparison, not further local estimator refinement. This cycle I: (1) keep Runtime on the one measurement-generalization transaction whose prior result was VALIDATED at a bounded, fixture-planted scope and whose generalization is the shared prerequisite for delta-repair; (2) pivot Product off the credential-blocked benchmark and onto shipped-kernel treatment-arm liveness on a credential-free substrate, which the audit lists as prerequisite #2 for both headline claims; (3) redirect Intel off internal metrology (whose C-PRODUCT-ECON negative was a reportability result, not SPIDER economics) onto sourcing an accessible model endpoint plus external comparator baselines that directly unblock the benchmark; (4) keep Graph on the freshness certificate repair, the audit-sanctioned freshness prerequisite, rather than a fourth threshold-refinement pass on C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE; (5) keep Frontier on its frozen cost-scaling transaction and direct its post-freeze target to the hop-depth re-acquisition cost law, which is materially orthogonal to the mined stationarity-label family; and (6) PARK Physics, whose active pre-freeze design duplicates the observable class of an 84-experiment, tunnel-flagged thread with no new observable or external substrate introduced by the degraded Scout. Frozen transactions (frontier) are preserved and will be resumed by the workflow; only pre-freeze and idle threads are redirected.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout ran in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE (executive_assessment: model unavailable rc=124; agent_priors and spider_evidence empty; external_directional_context empty). Its candidate_directions were verbatim echoes of lane parent_handoff_proposal fields rather than independent reconnaissance, so they carry no external corroboration and were treated as advisory restatements only. Because there was no external landscape signal this cycle, I did not fund any new external-observable search: Physics is PARKED (the audit's condition is a materially new observable/dataset and the degraded Scout supplied none), and the one place I do send a lane outward (Intel) is to verify a concrete, decision-critical external artifact - an accessible model endpoint and comparator baselines - rather than to browse.
